Class ShopBenefitRemoveEvent

com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.settings.type.benefit.ShopBenefitRemoveEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
QSCancellable, org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public class ShopBenefitRemoveEvent extends ShopSettingEvent<BigDecimal>
ShopBenefitRemoveEvent represents an event triggered when a benefit is removed from a shop. Handlers can use this to react to benefit removal.
